title: Obligations & Rules: Must, Mustn't & Have to
objective: Mampu menyatakan aturan, kewajiban, dan larangan di sekolah atau tempat umum menggunakan modal verb 'must' dan 'have to'

theory.summary: Dalam kehidupan sehari-hari, kita sering perlu menyampaikan aturan, kewajiban, atau larangan. Bahasa Inggris memiliki kata bantu khusus untuk ini: 'must', 'mustn't', dan 'have to'. Must digunakan untuk aturan yang sangat penting atau wajib (You must wear a helmet = Kamu harus pakai helm). Mustn't berarti larangan keras (You mustn't smoke here = Kamu tidak boleh merokok di sini). Have to juga berarti kewajiban, tetapi lebih netral dan sering untuk aturan eksternal (I have to finish my homework = Saya harus menyelesaikan PR saya). Don't have to berarti tidak wajib, bukan larangan (You don't have to pay = Kamu tidak harus bayar). Mari kita pelajari penggunaannya dengan benar!
rules: MUST + verb (base form) = kewajiban kuat atau aturan penting. Contoh: You must be quiet in the library (Kamu harus diam di perpustakaan). Students must wear uniforms (Murid-murid harus pakai seragam).

MUSTN'T + verb (base form) = larangan keras (tidak boleh). Contoh: You mustn't use your phone in class (Kamu tidak boleh pakai HP di kelas). We mustn't run in the corridor (Kita tidak boleh lari di koridor).

HAVE TO / HAS TO + verb (base form) = kewajiban (lebih netral dari must). Contoh: I have to finish my homework before 9 PM (Saya harus selesaikan PR sebelum jam 9 malam). She has to arrive on time (Dia harus tiba tepat waktu). DON'T HAVE TO / DOESN'T HAVE TO = tidak wajib (boleh tidak melakukan). Contoh: You don't have to bring lunch (Kamu tidak harus bawa makan siang).

commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pemula mencampuradukkan 'mustn't' dengan 'don't have to'. Ingat: mustn't = LARANGAN (tidak boleh), sedangkan don't have to = TIDAK WAJIB (boleh tidak melakukan, tapi juga boleh melakukan). Ini perbedaan yang sangat penting!
commonTrap.wrong: You don't have to smoke here. (Salah! Ini berarti 'kamu tidak harus merokok di sini' - seolah memberi izin)
commonTrap.correct: You mustn't smoke here. (Benar! Ini berarti 'kamu tidak boleh merokok di sini' - larangan keras)

vocab.collocation: You must wear a helmet when riding a motorcycle.
You mustn't talk loudly in the library.
Students must wear their school uniform every day.
We mustn't run in the corridor because it's dangerous.
I have to finish my homework before dinner.
You must ask for permission before leaving the classroom.
You have to wait in the queue at the cafeteria.
We have to submit the project before the deadline.
Everyone must follow the school rules.
You have to pay a fine if you return the book late.

dialogue.context: Seorang guru sedang menjelaskan aturan sekolah kepada siswa baru di hari pertama sekolah.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Good morning, everyone! Welcome to our school. Let me tell you about our school rules.
lines.translation: Selamat pagi, semuanya! Selamat datang di sekolah kami. Saya akan jelaskan aturan sekolah kami.

lines.speaker: Student
lines.text: Do we have to wear uniforms every day?
lines.translation: Apakah kami harus pakai seragam setiap hari?

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Yes, you must wear your uniform from Monday to Friday. But you don't have to wear it on Saturday for sports day.
lines.translation: Ya, kalian harus pakai seragam dari Senin sampai Jumat. Tapi kalian tidak harus pakainya di hari Sabtu untuk hari olahraga.

lines.speaker: Student
lines.text: Can we use our phones during class?
lines.translation: Bisakah kami pakai HP selama kelas?

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: No, you mustn't use phones in class. You have to keep them in your bags.
lines.translation: Tidak, kalian tidak boleh pakai HP di kelas. Kalian harus simpan di tas.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: In the library, you must be quiet. You mustn't talk loudly or eat food there.
lines.translation: Di perpustakaan, kalian harus tenang. Kalian tidak boleh bicara keras atau makan di sana.

lines.speaker: Student
lines.text: Thank you, Miss. I understand the rules now.
lines.translation: Terima kasih, Bu. Saya mengerti aturannya sekarang.

speakingLab.context: Anda berlatih bersama Mr. Khoirul tentang aturan di berbagai tempat umum. Mr. Khoirul akan menanyakan tentang aturan, dan Anda harus menjawab menggunakan must, mustn't, have to, atau don't have to.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today we're talking about rules in public places. Let's start with a simple question: What's one rule at school?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: We must wear uniforms at school.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Perfect! Now tell me, can you use your phone during lessons?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: No, we mustn't use our phones during lessons.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent! What about homework? Is it necessary to do it every day?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I have to do my homework every day.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Great job! Last question: Do you have to come to school on Sunday?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: No, I don't have to come to school on Sunday.

quiz.question: Students ___ wear their ID cards at school every day.
quiz.explanation: Jawaban yang benar adalah 'must' karena memakai ID card adalah kewajiban atau aturan penting di sekolah. Must digunakan untuk aturan yang wajib diikuti.

quiz.question: You ___ smoke in this building. It's against the law.
quiz.explanation: Jawaban yang benar adalah 'mustn't' karena ini adalah larangan keras. Mustn't berarti 'tidak boleh' dan digunakan untuk hal yang dilarang.

quiz.question: I ___ finish my project before Friday. That's the deadline.
quiz.explanation: Jawaban yang benar adalah 'have to' karena ini menunjukkan kewajiban dengan batas waktu eksternal (deadline). Have to cocok untuk kewajiban yang datang dari aturan atau situasi eksternal.

quiz.question: You ___ bring your own lunch. The school provides free meals.
quiz.explanation: Jawaban yang benar adalah 'don't have to' karena membawa makan siang sendiri tidak wajib (sekolah sudah menyediakan). Don't have to berarti 'tidak harus' atau 'boleh tidak melakukan'.

quiz.question: We ___ be quiet in the library. It's an important rule.
quiz.explanation: Jawaban yang benar adalah 'must' karena ini adalah aturan penting di perpustakaan. Must digunakan untuk menekankan kewajiban yang sangat penting dan harus diikuti.
